title: fix(kysely-adapter): detect SQLite rowid aliases correctly
body: ## Summary by cubic Fixes SQLite rowid-alias detection in the Kysely adapter. Schema validation previously scanned the CREATE TABLE SQL for `AUTOINCREMENT`, which misidentified `INTEGER PRIMARY KEY` rowid aliases as required columns. Detection now queries `PRAGMA index_list`: a column is generated when no primary-key index exists, matching how SQLite actually treats rowid aliases. - `INTEGER PRIMARY KEY` columns are now auto-incrementing even without `AUTOINCREMENT`. - `INTEGER PRIMARY KEY DESC`, `WITHOUT ROWID` tables, and non-`INTEGER` types are treated as required. - Removed the `AUTOINCREMENT` SQL scan, which failed on comments, quoted identifiers, and `AUTOINCREMENT` inside string defaults. - D1 batches statement-form `PRAGMA index_list` queries; other dialects use the same statement-form path with quoted identifiers when the dialect introspector is unavailable. Written for commit 3d99616045c30291eba6e75b94cb52c7f7503900. Summary will update on new commits.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+---
+"@better-auth/kysely-adapter": patch
+---
+
+Correctly detect database-generated SQLite primary keys during schema validation, including `INTEGER PRIMARY KEY` columns without `AUTOINCREMENT`.
